description: Configuration panel for TmPivotTable that allows drag-and-drop field arrangement into Row, Column, Value, and Filter areas.

parameters.name: AllowDragDrop
parameters.description: When true, enables drag-and-drop. Default: true.

parameters.name: AutoApplyFilters
parameters.description: When true, filter changes are applied immediately without clicking Apply. Default: true.

parameters.name: ColumnFieldKeys
parameters.description: Keys of fields currently in the column area.

parameters.name: Items
parameters.description: Source data items used to compute distinct filter values.

parameters.name: OnConfigurationChanged
parameters.description: Fires when the user applies a new configuration.

parameters.name: OnSortChanged
parameters.type: EventCallback<(string FieldKey, PivotSortDirection Direction, PivotSortBy SortBy)>
parameters.description: Fires when a field's sort direction or criterion changes.

parameters.name: RowFieldKeys
parameters.description: Keys of fields currently in the row area.

parameters.name: ShowFieldTree
parameters.description: When true, shows a checkbox tree instead of the Unused zone. Default: false.

parameters.name: ValueFields
parameters.description: Value field configurations in the data area.
